cases.case_label: Alu insertion in exon 3 of HESX1
cases.disease: Anterior pituitary aplasia (combined pituitary hormone deficiency) with retinal coloboma
cases.mechanism_detail: A homozygous Alu insertion in HESX1 exon 3 (homeodomain) leads to a major transcript lacking exon 3 and a minor transcript skipping exons 2 and 3, predicting severely truncated proteins.
cases.quote: The Alu-containing HESX1 allele generates a major transcript lacking this exon, and a minor one in which exons 2 and 3 are skipped, predicting severely truncated proteins.
